clips.title: The story
paras: Young tauren gather at Bloodhoof Village beside Stonebull Lake in central Mulgore. Led by Baine Bloodhoof, the village guides them from Camp Narache toward Thunder Bluff and tends the plains’ defense, trade, and rites.

Bloodhoof Village gathers tauren around Stonebull Lake in central Mulgore. Young tauren arrive from their trials at Camp Narache to hone their skills before traveling onward to the great mesas of Thunder Bluff. Patient breeders here tame wild kodo beasts for travel, while the village is also a center of craft and ceremony.

Baine Bloodhoof, son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, oversees daily governance and the region’s defense. Braves patrol the grasslands against aggressive wildlife, quilboar encroachers, and the Venture Company. Spiritual guides such as Zarlman Two-Moons tend to the tribe’s inner life and lead novices through sacred journeys like the Rite of Vision.
